reason: All three claims verified separately against interaction-check.mjs and the driven page. (1) Line 308 reads `.every((t) => /\s\S*…$/.test(t.shown) === false ? true : true)` — both ternary branches return true, so that conjunct is a literal tautology; the surviving conjunct `t.full.startsWith(t.shown.replace(/…$/, ''))` is a prefix test only, which a mid-word cut satisfies, so the property the assertion is named after is not tested. Driven at 320/360/390/432/768/1280 the clamp set is 7 elements with 0 actual cuts, so the assertion is vacuous twice over. (2) Replaying the exact filter at 541-550: owner-flight 11 of 11 buttons exempted, owner-empty 1 of 1 — the surviving array is empty by construction, and owner-editing is 19 of 19 too. The same filter on `publish` returns ["Send the link","Copy the link"]; render-b.js:681 builds both via act() with no data-act, the only click delegation in the file is render-b.js:499 `event.target.closest('[data-act]')`, and clicking each leaves document.body.innerHTML byte-identical. Two dead controls on the screen where the plan becomes theirs, and the state loop never visits that state. (3) At 573-577 the else branch asserts `plate.position === "fixed"` when `if (plate.position !== "fixed")` has already established exactly that — un-failable by construction. Measured: position is fixed at 390, 768 and 1024 and static at 1280/1440, so three of five widths spend their assertion restating the if. None of the three is merely weak: each predicate is provably constant, and none restates something the gates prove, because these are the gates.
sharpenedFix: Take the three separately; as written the fix trades one un-failable assertion for another in two of them. (1) 307-310: adopt the proposed word-boundary predicate (const stem = t.shown.replace(/…$/, ''); t.full === t.shown || t.full[stem.length] === ' '), but note it is vacuous today — 0 of 7 clamped strings are actually cut at any tested width. Guard that the cut set is non-empty at the narrow widths, or force a cut with a long fixture string, before asserting over it; otherwise the gate still cannot fail. (2) 541-550: keep the exemption list rather than dropping it wholesale, and add the proof beside it — for every button in .b-field and .b-press, snapshot innerHTML plus the root's data-state plus document.activeElement, click, wait 250ms, and require that one of the three changed; run that loop over owner-flight, owner-empty, owner-editing AND publish. The gate change only surfaces the defect: fixing it is a render-b.js:681 change — give "Send the link" and "Copy the link" real data-act handlers, or demote them to inert() spans per the file's own convention at render-b.js:258. (3) 573-577: do not assert that the edited row's .b-copy never intersects .b-edit — the sheet deliberately covers the foot of the measure (the comment at 570-572 says so) and at 390 it measurably overlaps 1 row, so that predicate would fail by design. Assert instead what the sheet actually owes: after openEditor and again after one stepper press, the EDITED row's .b-copy and every .b-edit control are fully inside the viewport, and the sheet does not cover the edited row itself.
